# Effect: flanger

Flanger: modulates a very short delay for a metallic sweep (jet sound).

**Where to put it**: Good as an accent on synths, guitar and drums; put it before the reverb, and usually not for a whole piece.

Latest parameters: `muser effects flanger` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rate_hz` | 0.2 | 0 – 100 Hz | Sweep rate. 0.1-0.3 slow sweep; >1 fast wobble |
| `feedback` | 0.7 | -0.95 – 0.95 | Resonance. Higher = more metallic |
| `mix` | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | Dry/wet mix. 0.5 gives the strongest effect |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "flanger", "rate_hz": 0.2, "feedback": 0.7, "mix": 0.5 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Slow-sweep jet (transitions)

  ```json
  {"type": "flanger", "rate_hz": 0.15, "feedback": 0.7, "mix": 0.5}
  ```

- Slight metallic coloring

  ```json
  {"type": "flanger", "rate_hz": 0.3, "feedback": 0.4, "mix": 0.35}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- The effect is very strong; it suits accenting a section or a single track, and it is not recommended on the main melody for the whole piece.
- Near feedback 0.95 the resonance is very sharp; watch the volume.
